results.question: Top 10 customers by revenue.

results.question: What are the 5 best-selling products by units sold?

FROM order_items AS oi

results.question: Which 5 sales reps generated the most revenue? Show their full names.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
  e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS rep,
  ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders AS o
JOIN employees AS e
  ON e.employee_id = o.sales_rep_id
WHERE
  o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY
  e.employee_id,
  rep
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: Top 10 customers by revenue last quarter.

FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c

GROUP BY
  c.customer_id,
  c.company_name

results.question: Which product category had the highest revenue from order line totals last quarter?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
  pc.name
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o
  USING (order_id)
JOIN products AS p
  USING (product_id)
JOIN product_categories AS pc
  USING (category_id)
WHERE
  o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '3 MONTHS'
  AND o.order_date < DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY
  pc.name
ORDER BY
  SUM(oi.line_total) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Which customers have outstanding unpaid invoices above their credit limit? Give the count.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*)
FROM (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id
  FROM customers AS c
  JOIN invoices AS i
    USING (customer_id)
  WHERE
    i.status IN ('sent', 'overdue')
  GROUP BY
    c.customer_id,
    c.credit_limit
  HAVING
    SUM(i.amount) > c.credit_limit
) AS t
LIMIT 200

results.question: Show quarterly revenue for the current year and the previous year.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT

  ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2)
FROM orders
WHERE
  status <> 'cancelled'
  AND order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
GROUP BY
  quarter
ORDER BY
  quarter
LIMIT 200
